Triage: `pm:queue`, type Bug, `domain:ui`. Not a fresh product decision: framework ADR-0090 D3 renamed `roles` → `positions` with no deprecation window, and the session face measurably no longer emits `roles` — consumers following the rename is the restoration of an existing ruling, so this dispatches. Severity anchor is site 2 (`sharedUserFeeds.approverIdentities`): role-addressed approvals silently vanish from the bell/Approvals/To-do — the framework's own docblock names this consumer. Site 1 (`AuthGuard.requiredRoles`) reads `positions` per the ADR; whether the scalar `user.role` fallback stays and how it relates to `packages/permissions`' separate surface are the dev's to settle **in the report** (stop-and-report if it turns genuinely contractual). Retiring the `roles?: string[]` mirror key in `packages/auth/src/types.ts` belongs in this card once site 1 is fixed (per #5389's note). `packages/permissions` stays out of scope as filed.

## PM · 验收(PR #5555 已开,待 CI)+ 两个待决问题的裁定 + 一条必须记下的生产者发现

### 交付

实现完成于断网期间,已推送:**PR #5555**(draft,`Refs #5424`,非 `Fixes`——站点 1 待裁)。分支 `claude/issue-5424-user-roles-retired-readers`,head `638b29283`,3 提交 / 7 文件,与派发 fence 逐一对上。**站点 1(`AuthGuard.tsx`)与 `packages/auth/src/types.ts` 未触碰**,拆分裁定守住了。

⚠️ 提交署名做过一次修正:原三个提交的 author/committer 是 `sales@objectstack.ai`,GitHub 会标 Unverified,已 rebase 重置为 `noreply@anthropic.com`。**内容零变化**——`git diff 64330ca49 HEAD` 为空,只有身份变了,基底 `eba3a6eaa` 未动。旧 SHA 作废。

### 两个待决问题,我的裁定

**Q1(`buildExpressionUser` 抽出后多一条 `react-refresh/only-export-components` 警告)—— 选 A,保持现状。** 留在 fence 内、0 errors、CI 不受影响,而且把规则的建议**留在可见处**。⛔ 明确不选 C:一条 `eslint-disable` 注释等于宣称这个安排永久没问题,而那是我没有立场下的判断——你自己也是这么说的,同意。B(新建模块)是个可有可无的后续,维护者想要再说。

**Q2(站点 2 与站点 3 身份来源不对称)—— 选 A,不动。** 该分歧**先于本卡存在**,B 和 C 都是超出重命名的行为变更:B 会让每个用户凭空多出 `role:<标量>` 身份、可能扩大生产环境的匹配集;C 会移除协议 17 仍在发的一个真实身份来源。没有 `pending_approvers` 实际authoring 方式的读数,两边都不能选。若徽章数与列表的分歧将来被报成 bug,单独立卡。

### 你查出的那条生产者发现,我复核了,而且它比看起来重要

```
packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx  (预览模式)
  setUser({ id:'preview-user', email, name, role, roles: [role] });
                                                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^ 仍在生产退役拼写,且无 positions
```

你建议挂到站点 1 的决策卡而不是单独派发,**理由成立**:预览模式恰恰就是还在喂 `AuthGuard.requiredRoles` 的东西,两者是同一根链条的两端。

我要补一句你没说满、但对裁决很关键的推论:**它证伪了「`roles` 已无生产者、只剩读者」这个前提**。如果站点 1 的裁决走「让 `AuthGuard` 改读 `positions`」,预览模式下的用户将**既没有 `positions`、又不再被读 `roles`**,于是 `requiredRoles` 会对每个预览用户全部拒绝。修好主路径会打坏预览路径。这条必须进入裁决考量。

⚠️ **本条本应记在站点 1 的决策卡上,但那张卡此刻对本会话不可见**(账号切换后有一段 issue 区间读不到)。先记在这里,以免丢失;可见性恢复后需转记过去。

第二条(`String(role).trim()` 对非字符串会产出字面量 `role:undefined`)属实且**当前不可达**,你判断不硬化是对的——超出本卡缺陷类别且会扩大 diff,而派发令要求的「缺失键」负控制已经覆盖了今天真实可达的那一面。

## PM · Landing recorded, and site 1 escalated

**PR #5555 MERGED 2026-08-21T11:05:26Z** (head `638b29283`, 7 files). Sites 2, 3 and 4 are closed. The prior seat session (`session_014zHsbJoTkTZeJQ5DLbRXrE`) reviewed and accepted this PR but went dark at 10:43Z before it could record the landing — this comment closes that half-state.

Card leaves `pm:dispatched`. It does **not** return to the queue: the residual is an access-control decision, which is maintainer floor, not seat discretion.

### Residual, re-measured on `origin/main` this round (not relayed)

`packages/auth/src/AuthGuard.tsx:58`:

```
const userRoles = user.roles ?? (user.role ? [user.role] : []);
```

Protocol 17 emits **no** `roles` key at all, so on every real deployment the left operand is `undefined` today and this gate already decides on the scalar `user.role` alone. That is worth stating plainly because it changes the severity from "a rename left one site behind" to "an access-control gate is answering on the wrong input right now":

- a gate written `requiredRoles={['finance_approver']}` refuses everyone who holds finance_approver as a **position** — the only place protocol 17 puts it;
- and it admits on the coarse scalar `role`, so `role: 'admin'` passes a gate meant for an `admin` **position**.

Both directions are live. Under- and over-admission on the same line.

`packages/auth/src/types.ts:85` keeps `roles?: string[]` declared solely because this file compiles against it, and its own docblock names this card as the owner of the retirement.

### The constraint that decides it — verified, and it is why this cannot be a seat call

`packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx:240-247`, preview mode:

```
id: 'preview-user',
…
roles: [role],        // no positions key anywhere in this object
```

So preview mode is the one identity source still **producing** the retired key, and producing no `positions`. The obvious fix — point site 1 at `positions` — **refuses every preview user at every `requiredRoles` gate**, because the synthetic user has no `positions` to match. Marketplace demo, and every preview/demo surface built on it, goes dark.

The prior session found this producer and correctly judged it load-bearing; I verified it rather than relaying it. It means there is no version of this change that touches only one file.

---

<!-- four-prism -->
**四棱分析(业务角度)**

**一句话问题:** 权限门 `requiredRoles` 今天用错了输入来判断「你能不能进这个页面」——真实部署里它只看那个粗粒度的单一角色,看不见用户真正的岗位;而唯一还在喂旧字段的是演示模式,所以修好正式环境就会弄黑演示环境。

**选项(客户可感知的代价):**

| | 做法 | 客户看到什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | 门改读 `positions`,同时把演示模式改成也发 `positions` | 正式环境权限判断恢复正确;演示环境需同批改,漏改则演示全黑 |
| **B** | 门同时读 `positions` 和 `roles` | 两边都不黑,但等于把 ADR-0090 D3 明令禁止的别名复活,旧拼写永久留存 |
| **C** | 保持现状 | 岗位持有者继续被错误拒绝,粗粒度角色继续被错误放行 |

**业务直译与行业类比:** 相当于门禁系统改用工牌上的「部门」判断,但读卡器还在读已经停用的「职务」栏——正式员工刷不进自己该进的门,而临时演示用的假工牌反而畅通。

**四轴论证:**
- **实际业务需求** — 审批、财务等按岗位授权的页面今天就在错判,是已发生的客户可感知损伤,不是投机能力面。
- **项目长远合理性** — A 收敛到唯一已发布拼写 `positions`,与 ADR-0090 D3 同向;B 是长期技术债,且违背该 ADR 的明文。
- **防 AI 写错** — A 让「一个字段一个含义」成立,AI 写权限元数据时不会在两个拼写间猜;B 恰恰制造两个都对的拼写,是 AI 批量写错的温床。
- **创业阶段不扩散** — A 是一次性收敛,不新增面;B 新增一条需要永久维护的兼容路径。

**推荐:** A。**回退:** 若演示模式改造成本超出预期,可先只修正式路径并显式把演示模式标记为已知缺口立卡,⛔ 不走 B。

**本分析看不见什么:** 我没有度量 `requiredRoles` 在真实客户部署里的实际调用点数量与它们各自门的是什么页面,所以「今天有多少客户正在被错误拒绝」这个量级未知;也没有读 `packages/permissions` 那条独立权限面与本门的关系(分诊评论点名过它,但本卡范围之外)。若这两点中任一显示影响面极小,C(保持现状、另行安排)可能反而是对的。

## Maintainer ruling recorded (2026-08-22, supplemental to the decision-inbox digest, skills seat `session_01ApyDuQY2fkunMCqXiqvBhR`)

This card was omitted from the 46-card digest and presented separately with a four-axis recommendation; the maintainer ruled: 同意 (Option A).

**Ruled:** Option A — the gates read `positions`. `AuthGuard`'s `requiredRoles` matches against `user.positions` (keeping the `user.role` scalar fallback), and all four sites are fixed in the same batch: the two approver-identity derivations (`sharedUserFeeds.ts`, `approvalsApi.ts`) derive role-addressed identities from `positions`, and the vestigial `roles` forwarding in `AppContent.tsx` is removed. Once the last reader is gone, the hand-copied `roles?: string[]` mirror key in `packages/auth/src/types.ts` retires with it, so any future misread dies at compile time. Explicitly NOT ruled: a compatibility shadow key re-emitting `roles` — that would undo the deliberate no-deprecation-window rename. The separate `roles` surface in `packages/permissions` stays out of scope, as the card states.

State: `needs-user-decision` removed → `pm:queue` (ready for dispatch).

**Premise re-verified on `origin/main` `c7cd2b60b`** — every line below measured this round, not relayed:

- `AuthGuard.tsx:58` — `const userRoles = user.roles ?? (user.role ? [user.role] : []);` and `:59` matches `requiredRoles.some(...)`. Unchanged since filing.
- `AuthProvider.tsx:250` — preview mode still emits `roles: [role]`, and **no `positions` key in that object**.
- `types.ts:85` — `roles?: string[]` still declared.

**The severity is worse than a stale rename, and both directions are live.** Protocol 17 emits no `roles` at all, so today the left operand is always `undefined` and this gate already decides on the coarse scalar `user.role` alone: a `requiredRoles={['finance_approver']}` gate **refuses** everyone holding that as a position (the only place protocol 17 puts it), and **admits** on `role: 'admin'` for a gate meant for an `admin` position. Under- and over-admission on one line.

**⚠️ The constraint that made this a maintainer call, and the thing to measure first.** Preview mode is the one identity source still *producing* the retired key and producing no `positions`. The naive fix — point site 1 at `positions` only — refuses every preview user at every `requiredRoles` gate, and every demo surface built on it goes dark. **My reading, which is a PM mechanism assumption and not a ruling: the ruling's "keeping the `user.role` scalar fallback" is exactly what prevents that**, because preview mode does set `role`. **Measure whether the scalar fallback fully covers preview mode, or whether preview must also emit `positions`.** If it must, that is inside this card's fence (`AuthProvider.tsx` is granted) — say so and do it; do not leave preview half-fixed.

⛔ **Explicitly NOT ruled and not to be invented:** a compatibility shadow key re-emitting `roles`. That would undo the deliberate no-deprecation-window rename of ADR-0090 D3. ⛔ `packages/permissions` has its own unrelated `roles` surface and stays **out of scope**, as the card states.

## ACCEPT (on merits) — PR #5724 · reviewer of record, `domain:ui` seat, round 18

⚠️ **On merits, not yet cleared to land.** Gates read **by name** at head `cc6e27d7a`, two minutes after the PR opened: 12 `success` + 3 `skipped` + **7 `in_progress`** (four shards, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Doc Snippet Type Check`) = 22. ⛔ Not flipped ready and not enqueued until 19 success + 3 skipped is verified by name.

**Fence verified against the tree:** 6 files — `AuthGuard.tsx`, `AuthProvider.tsx`, `types.ts`, two test files, one changeset. **Nothing outside `packages/auth` + `.changeset`.** `packages/permissions` untouched, as the ruling requires. Sites 2/3/4 confirmed already landed on `origin/main` and not re-touched.

**Content spot-checked independently of the report:** the gate now matches `user.positions`, falling back to the scalar *"only when the session carries no `positions` key at all"*; `types.ts` carries a tombstone where `roles?: string[]` was, and `positions?: string[]` is still declared at `:377` — the control that makes the removal a real absence rather than a broken grep.

### The PM assumption was measured, not inherited — and the measurement design is the part worth keeping

I flagged as a mechanism assumption that the ruling's *"keeping the `user.role` scalar fallback"* is what stops preview mode going dark, and asked for it to be measured rather than adopted. The dev isolated it properly with a **targeted reverse leg**: reverting `AuthProvider.tsx` **alone**, under the new gate, gave `1 failed | 8 passed` — only the producer-retirement pin red, and **both preview gate cases green**. That is a clean single-variable measurement of exactly the claim, and it **confirms** the inference: preview users still pass every gate via the scalar path.

Preview then emits `positions: [role]` anyway — correctly, because Option A names it, it retires the last producer of the dead key, and it aligns preview with every other `positions` consumer. Fixing it because the ruling says so, having first proven the sky would not have fallen otherwise, is the right order.

**A positive control I want to single out.** Removing a key from a type is easy to do cosmetically — the declaration disappears and nothing proves anything downstream changed. The dev pasted `user?.roles?.includes('admin')` back in and got `error TS2339: Property 'includes' does not exist on type '{}'` — **the card's own measured signature**, from when the prior attempt to retire this key failed for exactly that reason. That converts "the key is gone" from an assertion into a demonstration that a future misread dies at compile time, which is the whole point of the retirement.

**Both directions pinned, as this being an access-control gate required.** The four direction pins are named and each turned red under reverse leg A (`AuthGuard.tsx` reverted): position-holder **admission**, coarse-scalar **refusal**, empty-positions **authority**, and the retired spelling **dead**. That third one is a semantic refinement worth recording: an empty `positions` array is an *authoritative* "no positions", not a missing signal, so the scalar fallback is not consulted for it. A fix that only proved "the right people now get in" would have left over-admission untested; this one tests both.

**Type-check ran in the downstream-consumer direction** — `turbo type-check --filter=...@object-ui/auth`, i.e. auth **and its dependents**, 40/40 tasks. That is the direction a contract change owes, and it is what a package-scoped run would have missed.

**Clause ② at-tier, no review chain owed.** Declared `yes` and dispatched at `claude-fable-5` = `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, under the maintainer's standing authorization; `needs:contract-review` does not exist in this repo and none is owed for an at-tier dispatch.

Landing blocked only on the seven pending gates. Closes via `Fixes #5424` on merge.
